objective.text: Request command isolation explicitly and select the exit code when its lock is unavailable.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish skipping due to contention from successfully doing the requested work.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A command implements Isolatable. When another instance holds its isolation lock, a monitoring script must receive exit code 12 instead of interpreting the skipped run as success. Which invocation selects that contention exit code?

options.text: php artisan sync:catalog --isolated followed by checking only exit code 0
options.rationale: The default contention exit is success unless configured otherwise, so this does not express the required 12.
options.misconception: The default contention exit is success unless configured otherwise, so this does not express the required 12.

options.rationale: tries is not the command isolation contention exit-code option.
options.misconception: tries is not the command isolation contention exit-code option.

options.rationale: A numeric value supplied to isolated is used as the exit code when the isolation mutex cannot be acquired.
A timeout setting does not select the status returned on failure to acquire the command isolation mutex.
options.misconception: A timeout setting does not select the status returned on failure to acquire the command isolation mutex.
